concept: screen recording of the template scrolling in the 9:16 player (5 reels), static title card first
motionStyle: auto-scroll with pauses at each section
typeTreatment: the template's own type, no added type
sound: generated music bed from the player (mood-matched), no sound design

concept: screen recording, no intro card, on-screen hook pill for 3 s, 18 s (experiment E1)
note: still a scrolling screen recording; the motion-director format below is the first film

concept: The Hue Dial: one turn of a colour dial drives every swatch; the last turn lands on tangerine, last frame = first frame
motionStyle: virtual camera over the live page (macro push, pull-back, whips, 3D tilt, speed-ramped spin), springs on type, hard cuts on downbeats
primaryTransition: match cut on colour (tangerine swatch -> tangerine dial read-out)
transitions: iris wipe from the CTA (loop seam)
typeTreatment: template type system (Gabarito 900 / Martian Mono), per-word mask reveals locked to the beat, max 6 words per card
grade: template colours kept true; grain, vignette that closes in the breath, highlight bloom, contrast 1.04 / saturation 1.05
sound: 120 BPM E-minor pentatonic: kick/hat/clap, plucked bass, marimba arp, one rising bell note per dial tick, J-cut whooshes, riser and impact, 0.8 s of silence before the reveal
cover: dedicated poster: hook headline + swatch fan on a hue ring, safe for the 1:1 and 3:4 grid crops

variants.A: typographic open: hook words slam on flat tangerine on the beats, hard cut to the page on beat 3 (hypothesis: type-first is the stronger stopper for cold viewers)
variants.B: macro open: tangerine swatch fills the frame and pulls back to the hook (hypothesis: a surprising image beats text for scroll-stopping)

concept: After 8: a colour-scripted day-to-night-to-dawn story; the clinic building's windows are the appointment diary, they light up one by one as WhatsApp bookings arrive at night and sunrise turns them gold; dawn returns to frame 0, so the loop is the story
motionStyle: layered parallax world (sky, stars, clouds, skyline, building, floating 3D phone, glass UI) on a 100 BPM grid; springy per-letter kinetic type with a variable width axis; scale punch on the sunrise impact
primaryTransition: light transition (the sky itself grades golden hour -> dusk -> night -> dawn; no wipes)
transitions: neon flicker on the beat (OPEN dies at 8 pm, BOOKING OPEN 24x7 lights)
phone rises into the dusk and leaves upward
push into the building at night
breath dim then sunrise flare and light leak
OPEN flickers back on at 9 am into the loop
typeTreatment: Archivo 900 uppercase per-letter entries, wdth 125 -> 74-90 on a damped spring; Geist Mono HUD clock and tally; glass toasts
grade: colour script mixed in oklch: rose/peach/butter golden hour, violet/magenta/coral dusk, ink/cobalt/electric-indigo night, periwinkle/pink/peach dawn; warm amber window glow (srgb mix), lime neon accent
sound: effects only at 100 BPM (word clicks, 8 pm impact, neon sparkle, message clicks, a click+tick per night booking, riser into the held breath, big impact on sunrise); music by Instagram audio near 100 BPM
cover: night poster: lit building, moon, clock 11:42 PM and the hook in white type

variants.A: type-first open on flat red (owner's choice for the format)

notes: v2 after owner feedback (v1 was a page pan in the page's own colours). Style-frame passes: 1) iframe of file:// had no contentDocument -> same-document clone; bookings lit at dawn (story backwards) -> re-timed into the night with glass toasts; hook collided with the sign; flat building -> side face, roof, tank, antenna, mullions; orange golden hour -> rose/butter; last frame did not match the first. 2) zoomed sign inside the IG top zone -> smaller push; toasts overlapped; home windows pink (oklch drift) -> srgb mix; sun hidden behind the building. 3) phone lingered at 9.2 s; impact punch added. 4) OPEN sign relights at 9 am and the clock fades so the loop matches.
